feed.text: Checked 9 batches across 4 distributors. MF-2410-118 fails all three quick-commerce gates and will not sell through.
Asked Lakshmi Agencies for one label photo before quoting any price.
Sent one photo of the carton label.
Read the label: batch MF-2410-118, MFG 27 Apr 2026, best before 24 Oct 2026, MRP ₹20.00, confidence 0.98. Matches the DMS record.
Priced five channels against 21 days left. Destroying costs −₹14.34 a unit, −₹23,059 for the batch.

We route 1,372 units to the Kirana cluster at ₹12, 150 to Staff sale at ₹8, and 86 to the Food bank at ₹0. ExpireSoon pays ₹10 but is ineligible due to short days left, so we fill available capacity. This gives a swing against writing the batch off of ₹22,258.
Sent Priya the plan to review, and Lakshmi Agencies the same plan with a pause button.
Approved the plan from the phone.
Mango Drink batch: booked Feeding India for 86 units. India FoodBanking Network needs 21+ days and 100+ units.
Pushed the Hindi scheme to 58 kiranas in the Hyderabad cluster: buy 10 get 2 for 48 hours, no shop over 4× its own 14-day sales.
52 of 58 kiranas ordered all 1,372 units in about 19 hours, each under its cap.
Recorded the staff sale at Begum Bazaar godown: 150 of 150 packs sold.
Issued the price-support credit note CN/0117 and wrote the ITC memo.
Ran the Tuesday round: 52 drops, 1,372 packets.
Expiry day: the journey closed as it stood, with every pack gone.
The return window closed on 4 Oct. Posted the ledger: 345.7 kg diverted, 864.3 kg CO₂e avoided (indicative), 86 meals. BRSR row written.
